entries.이 약은 육체피로, 임신·수유기, 병중·병후(병을 앓는 동안이나 회복 후: This medicine is used to supply vitamins B1, B2, and B6 during physical fatigue, pregnancy and lactation, and reduced physical strength during or after illness (while ill or after recovery), and for the relief of neuralgia, muscle pain, joint pain (low back pain, stiff shoulders, etc.), angular cheilitis (inflammation of the corners of the mouth), cheilitis (inflammation of the lips), stomatitis (inflammation inside the mouth), glossitis (inflammation of the tongue), eczema, and dermatitis, as well as for beriberi and eye fatigue.

This medicine is used to supply vitamins B2 and B6 during physical fatigue, pregnancy and lactation, and reduced physical strength during or after illness (while ill or after recovery), for the relief of angular cheilitis (inflammation of the corners of the mouth), cheilitis (inflammation of the lips), stomatitis (inflammation inside the mouth), glossitis (inflammation of the tongue), eczema, and dermatitis, and for muscle cramps due to magnesium deficiency.
entries.이 약은 육체피로, 임신·수유기, 병중·병후의 체력저하 시, 노년기의 비: This medicine is used to supply vitamins E, B1, B2, B6, and C during physical fatigue, pregnancy and lactation, reduced physical strength during or after illness, and old age, for the relief of neuralgia, muscle pain, joint pain (low back pain, stiff shoulders, etc.), angular cheilitis (inflammation of the corners of the mouth), cheilitis (inflammation of the lips), stomatitis (inflammation inside the mouth), glossitis (inflammation of the tongue), eczema, and dermatitis, for beriberi and eye fatigue, for the relief of peripheral circulatory disorders and, during menopause, stiff shoulders and neck and numbness and coldness of the hands and feet (cold hands and feet), and to supply zinc.
entries.이 약은 육체피로, 임신ㆍ수유기, 병중ㆍ병후(병을 앓는 동안이나 회복 후: This medicine is used to supply vitamins B1, B2, B6, and C during physical fatigue, pregnancy and lactation, and reduced physical strength during or after illness (while ill or after recovery), for the relief of the symptoms of neuralgia, muscle pain, joint pain (low back pain, stiff shoulders, etc.), angular cheilitis (inflammation of the corners of the mouth), cheilitis (inflammation of the lips), stomatitis (inflammation inside the mouth), glossitis (inflammation of the tongue), eczema, dermatitis, beriberi, and eye fatigue, and to supply zinc.

This medicine is used to supply vitamins D, B1, B2, and B6 during physical fatigue, pregnancy and lactation, reduced physical strength during or after illness (while ill or after recovery), the growth period, and old age, for the relief of the symptoms of neuralgia, muscle pain, and joint pain (low back pain, stiff shoulders, etc.), and for beriberi and eye fatigue.

This medicine is used to supply vitamins A, B1, and B2 during physical fatigue, pregnancy and lactation, reduced physical strength during or after illness (while ill or after recovery), and old age, and for the relief of dryness of the eyes, night blindness (difficulty seeing at night), neuralgia, muscle pain, joint pain (low back pain, stiff shoulders, etc.), angular cheilitis (inflammation of the corners of the mouth), cheilitis (inflammation of the lips), stomatitis (inflammation inside the mouth), glossitis (inflammation of the tongue), eczema, dermatitis, beriberi, and eye fatigue.
This medicine is used for the short-term relief of the symptoms of pharyngitis.
entries.이 약은 장내균총 이상(항생물질, 화학요법제 투여 등)에 의한 정장, 변: This medicine is used to regulate the bowels and improve constipation, loose stools, abdominal distension, and abnormal intestinal fermentation caused by disturbance of the intestinal flora (due to administration of antibiotics, chemotherapeutic agents, etc.).
entries.이 약은 정신적·신체적 기능무력 증상의 보조요법 및 회복 기간(아미노산: This medicine is used as adjunctive therapy for symptoms of mental and physical asthenia and as adjunctive therapy during the recovery period (a state of amino acid deficiency).
This medicine is used as adjunctive treatment for detoxification in severe liver disease (e.g. liver cirrhosis).
entries.이 약은 치열·치핵의 아픔, 가려움, 부종(부기), 출혈의 일시적 완화에: This medicine is used for the temporary relief of pain, itching, edema (swelling), and bleeding from anal fissures and hemorrhoids.
entries.이 약은 코감기(급성비염(코염)), 알레르기성 비염(코염) 또는 부비동염: This medicine is used for the relief of nasal congestion, runny nose, sneezing, and a heavy feeling in the head caused by a head cold (acute rhinitis (nasal inflammation)), allergic rhinitis (nasal inflammation), or sinusitis.
entries.이 약은 콧물, 코막힘, 재채기, 인후통, 기침, 가래, 춥고 떨리는 증: This medicine is used for the relief of various cold symptoms such as runny nose, nasal congestion, sneezing, sore throat, cough, phlegm, chills in which one feels cold and shivers, fever, headache, joint pain, and muscle pain.
entries.이 약을 다른 점안제와 동시에 사용할 경우, 다른 점안제를 먼저 사용하고: If using this medicine at the same time as other eye drops, use the other eye drops first and use this medicine about 10 minutes later.
entries.이 약을 복용하기 전에 약에 의한 발진, 발적(충혈되어 붉어짐), 가려움: Before taking this medicine, those who have experienced rash, redness (congested and reddened skin), or itching caused by medicines should consult a doctor or pharmacist.Strictly observe the specified dosage and administration.
entries.이 약을 복용하는 동안 다른 비스테로이드성 소염진통제, ACE 억제제 또: While taking this medicine, do not take it together with other non-steroidal anti-inflammatory analgesics, ACE inhibitors or angiotensin II receptor antagonists, aspirin, diuretics, lithium, methotrexate, coumarin anticoagulants (such as warfarin), cyclosporine and tacrolimus, antiplatelet agents and selective serotonin reuptake inhibitors (SSRIs), or corticosteroids.Before taking this medicine, patients who are concurrently being treated for peptic ulcer with misoprostol or the like should consult a doctor or pharmacist.
entries.이 약을 복용하는 동안 다른 해열진통제, 감기약, 진정제를 복용하지 마십: While taking this medicine, do not take other antipyretic analgesics, cold remedies, or sedatives.Before taking this medicine, people receiving antidiabetic medicines, gout medicines, arthritis medicines, anticoagulants, steroids, etc. should consult a doctor or pharmacist.Patients receiving barbiturates, tricyclic antidepressants, or alcohol should consult a doctor or pharmacist.Do not drink alcohol while taking it.
entries.이 약을 복용하는 동안 진해거담제, 다른 감기약, 해열진통제, 진정제,: While taking this medicine, do not take it together with antitussives and expectorants, other cold remedies, antipyretic analgesics, sedatives, oral medicines containing antihistamines (oral preparations for rhinitis, motion sickness medicines, anti-allergy medicines), or MAO inhibitors (antidepressants, antipsychotics, mood regulators, antiparkinsonian agents, etc.).People receiving other medicines such as barbiturates, tricyclic antidepressants and alcohol, potassium-containing preparations, licorice-containing preparations, preparations containing glycyrrhizic acid or its salts, loop diuretics (furosemide, etacrynic acid) or thiazide diuretics (trichlormethiazide), antidiabetic medicines, gout medicines, arthritis medicines, anticoagulants, or steroids should consult a doctor or pharmacist before taking this medicine.Do not drink alcohol while taking it.
entries.이 약을 사용하기 전에 눈의 통증이 심한 사람, 안약에 의한 알레르기 증: Before using this medicine, people with severe eye pain, those who have experienced allergic symptoms caused by eye drops (e.g. congestion of the eye, itching, swelling, rash, congested and reddened skin, etc.), and patients with glaucoma should consult a doctor or pharmacist.Strictly observe the specified dosage and administration.Use this medicine for ophthalmic instillation only.Do not use it as a wetting solution for soft contact lenses or while wearing soft contact lenses.Do not let the tip of the container touch the eyelid or eyelashes, and do not use it if it has become cloudy.Do not share it with other people.If there is no improvement in symptoms after several days of use, stop using it immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist.Do not use it beyond its expiry date, and once opened, use it as soon as possible.
entries.이 약을 사용하기 전에 안약에 알레르기 증상(충혈, 가려움, 부종(부기): Before using this medicine, those who have experienced allergic symptoms to eye drops (congestion, itching, edema (swelling), rash, congested and reddened skin, etc.) or allergic symptoms to sulfa drugs (rash, congested and reddened skin, itching, nausea, fever, etc.), patients with glaucoma, and patients with severe eye pain should consult a doctor or pharmacist.Strictly observe the specified dosage and administration.Use this medicine for ophthalmic instillation only.Do not use it as a wetting solution for soft contact lenses or while wearing soft contact lenses.Do not use it if it has become cloudy (turbid).To prevent contamination, avoid sharing it with others as far as possible.If there is no improvement in symptoms after 3 to 4 days of use, stop using it immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist.
entries.이 약을 사용하는 동안 다른 소염진통제, ACE 저해제, 아스피린, 푸로: While using this medicine, do not take (use) it together with other anti-inflammatory analgesics, ACE inhibitors, aspirin, furosemide, lithium, methotrexate, or warfarin.
Do not use it together with phosphate-containing eye drops.
entries.인산염, 칼슘염, 경구용 테트라사이클린계 제제, 제산제, 레보도파와 함께: Do not take it together with phosphates, calcium salts, oral tetracycline preparations, antacids, or levodopa.If taking it together with cardiac glycosides, oral contraceptives containing estrogen, antialdosterone agents, or triamterene, consult a doctor or pharmacist.Avoid teas containing tannin, such as green tea and black tea, while taking it and before and after taking it.

Do not take it together with phosphates, calcium salts, oral tetracycline preparations, antacids, or levodopa.If using it together with antialdosterone agents or triamterene, consult a doctor or pharmacist.Avoid teas containing tannin, such as green tea and black tea, while taking it and before and after taking it.
entries.인산염, 칼슘염, 비경구 철분제제 또는 비경구 수산화제이철폴리말토스복염제: Do not take it together with phosphates, calcium salts, parenteral iron preparations, or parenteral iron(III) hydroxide polymaltose complex preparations.If taking it together with iron-containing preparations (iron supplements, liver contrast agents for MRI, etc.), antialdosterone agents, triamterene, diphosphonate salts, thyroxine, cefdinir preparations, quinolones, penicillamine, cholestyramine, preparations such as pancreatic extract and vitamin E, or 200 mg or more of ascorbic acid (vitamin C), consult a doctor or pharmacist.Avoid teas containing tannin, such as green tea and black tea, and milk and dairy products while taking it and before and after taking it.
entries.작열감, 자통 또는 동통, 가려움, 발진, 홍반, 때때로 구역, 피부건조: If a burning sensation, stinging or pain, itching, rash, or erythema, occasionally nausea, dry skin, tenderness, edema, contact dermatitis, or increased exudate, or rarely a systemic allergic reaction occurs, stop using it immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist.
entries.정해진 용법과 용량을 잘 지키십시오.이 약은 치과용으로만 사용하고 안과용: Strictly observe the specified dosage and administration.Use this medicine for dental use only; do not use it for ophthalmic or other purposes.If there is no improvement in symptoms after several applications, stop administration and consult a doctor or pharmacist.
entries.졸음, 두통, 때때로 권태감, 마비감, 무력증, 초조, 감각이상, 드물게: If drowsiness or headache; occasionally malaise, a sensation of numbness, asthenia, restlessness, or paresthesia; rarely mild and transient lassitude, fatigue, dizziness, a heavy feeling in the head, excitement, convulsions, dyskinesia, dystonia, fainting, tremor, aggression, confusion, depression, hallucinations, insomnia, tic disorder, amnesia, memory impairment, suicidal ideation, or nightmares; occasionally thirst, dryness of the lips, nausea, loss of appetite, gastric discomfort, indigestion, abdominal pain, stomach pain, abdominal discomfort, or diarrhea; rarely vomiting, gastrointestinal disorders, cheilitis, taste disturbance, or increased appetite; rarely tachycardia, arrhythmia, or a rise in blood pressure; occasionally palpitations or vasculitis; occasionally leukopenia, neutropenia, lymphocytosis, or eosinophilia; rarely monocytosis, an increase or decrease in platelets, or photosensitivity; rarely hypersensitivity and anaphylactic shock, urticaria, angioneurotic edema, fixed drug eruption, or acute generalized exanthematous pustulosis; rarely blurred vision, conjunctival congestion, disturbance of ocular accommodation, oculogyric crisis, vertigo, or hepatitis; occasionally elevated BUN, glycosuria, or blood-stained urine; rarely difficulty urinating, nocturnal enuresis, urinary retention, joint pain, muscle pain, pharyngitis, cough, nosebleed, bronchospasm, hearing abnormalities, or visual abnormalities; occasionally chest pain; or rarely menstrual irregularity, ringing in the ears, rhinitis, or weight gain occurs, stop taking it immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist.Itching, urticaria, and the like may occur after stopping this medicine.
entries.증상이 악화되거나 알레르기 반응(발진, 발적, 가려움 등)이 나타날 경우: If symptoms worsen or an allergic reaction (rash, redness, itching, etc.) occurs, stop administration immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist.
entries.진해거담제(가래약), 다른 감기약, 해열진통제, 진정제, 항히스타민제를: Do not take it together with antitussives and expectorants (phlegm medicines), other cold remedies, antipyretic analgesics, sedatives, or oral medicines containing antihistamines (oral preparations for rhinitis, motion sickness medicines, anti-allergy medicines).People who are taking MAO inhibitors (antidepressants, antipsychotics, mood regulators, antiparkinsonian agents, etc.) or who stopped taking them within the past 2 weeks must not take this medicine.If taking it together with barbiturates, tricyclic antidepressants, potassium-containing preparations, licorice-containing preparations, preparations containing glycyrrhizic acid or its salts, loop diuretics (furosemide, etacrynic acid), or thiazide diuretics (trichlormethiazide), consult a doctor or pharmacist.Do not drink alcohol while taking it.
Apply an appropriate amount to the diseased area several times a day.
entries.충혈되어 붉어짐, 부종(부기), 자극감, 알레르기 증상(발진, 충혈되어: If congested and reddened skin, edema (swelling), a sensation of irritation, allergic symptoms (rash, congested and reddened skin, itching, etc.), or bleeding occurs, stop using it immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist.
Do not take it together with theophylline, ritonavir, or excessive amounts of alcohol.
entries.트림, 구역, 구토, 때때로 구강마비감, 자상감, 작열감, 드물게 과민반: Belching, nausea, vomiting, occasionally a sensation of numbness in the mouth, a stinging sensation, or a burning sensation, and rarely hypersensitivity reactions may occur.
entries.피부의 발진, 발적, 가려움, 자극감(통증, 발열, 따가움), 부스럼 딱: If skin rash, redness, itching, a sensation of irritation (pain, heat, stinging), or a condition in which the skin peels like a scab occurs, stop using it immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist.
entries.피부의 진균(칸디다증, 백선 등) 및 세균(전염성 고름딱지증, 오염 등): If fungal skin infections (candidiasis, ringworm, etc.) or bacterial skin infections (impetigo contagiosa, contamination, etc.), a sensation of skin irritation, rash, or blurred vision of unknown frequency occurs, stop using it immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist.
entries.필요 시 증상이 있는 눈에 1~2방울씩 점안하고, 점안 후 남은 액과 용: As needed, instill 1 to 2 drops into the affected eye, and after instillation discard the remaining solution and the container.
entries.해열진통제, 다른 비스테로이드성 소염진통제, 혈소판 응집 억제제(예: 아: Do not use it together with antipyretic analgesics, other non-steroidal anti-inflammatory analgesics, platelet aggregation inhibitors (e.g. aspirin), oral anticoagulants (e.g. warfarin), or high-dose methotrexate.If using it together with antihypertensives, diuretics, angiotensin-converting enzyme inhibitors, angiotensin II antagonists, cardiac glycosides, cyclosporine, tacrolimus, glucocorticoids, lithium preparations, low-dose methotrexate, mifepristone, oral hypoglycemic agents, phenytoin, potassium-sparing diuretics, probenecid, sulfinpyrazone, quinolone antibacterials, selective serotonin reuptake inhibitors, or zidovudine, consult a doctor or pharmacist.
entries.혈액학적 이상반응이 나타나는 경우 복용을 즉각 중지하고 의사 또는 약사와: If hematological adverse reactions occur, stop taking it immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist.
